newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's new parliament to meet on October 22.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's new parliament to meet on October 22.

text.p: Lebanon's newly elected parliament will meet for the first time on October 22 to elect a speaker, Minister of State Kabalan Isa al-Khoury said on Thursday.

Khoury told reporters he had quit his government post so that as the oldest member of parliament he can exercise his right to act as interim chief of the new assembly until the 128 deputies elect a new speaker.
Parliamentary sources said Nabih Berri, the Syrian-backed speaker of the outgoing parliament, was the only candidate for the post which is reserved for a Shi'ite Moslem.
